posts.title: Community Before Launch
posts.text:
A meme coin launch can create attention. Only community turns attention into momentum.

Build trust, culture, distribution, resilience, and real participation before opening the market.

Build the people. Then build the market.

#MADGER #CryptoEducation

posts.title: Community Before Launch
posts.text:
COMMUNITY BEFORE LAUNCH

Liquidity can open a market—but it cannot create belief, culture, or loyalty.

Building community first gives a meme coin:

🤝 Trust — People understand the mission.
🎭 Culture — Memes, language, and shared experiences create identity.
📣 Distribution — Real supporters carry the story beyond paid promotion.
🛡 Resilience — An invested community is more likely to keep creating through volatility.
📈 Momentum — When the market opens, demand already has a network through which it can grow.

Launching before developing these foundations can produce temporary attention without durable participation.

The strongest meme coins are not merely tokens with audiences. They are communities with tokens.

Build the people. Then build the market.

#MADGER #TheBurrow #CommunityBeforeLaunch #MemecoinCommunity #CryptoEducation #SolanaCommunity
